texts.preamble: M/S.Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India ... vs Vasantha Bhavan on 2 July, 2024 Author: P.Velmurugan Bench: P.Velmurugan C.S.(Comm.Div IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT MADRAS Dated : 02.07.2024 CORAM: THE HONOURABLE Mr. JUSTICE P.VELMURUGAN C.S. (Comm. Div.) No.36 of 2024 M/s. Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India Private Limited, Represented by its Director, Anand Krishnan Having office at No.34, Developed Plots (South Phase), Industrial Estate, Guindy, Chennai 600 032. Vs. Vasantha Bhavan, No.144, Ennore High Road, Tondiarpet, Chennai 600 081. . Civil Suit is filed under Order VII Rule 1 Civil Procedure with Order IV Rule 1 of the High Court Original Side Rules and Secti and Section 135 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999, praying for a judgment decree against the defendant: 1/14 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Com M/S.Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India ... vs Vasantha Bhavan on 2 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8711508/ 1 a) granting a permanent injunction restraining the defenda men, servants, agents or anyone claiming through or under them from manner infringing the plaintiff trademark and trading style VASANTA BHAVAN by using the offending Trademark and Trading style VASANTA BHAVAN or any other mark or marks which are similar or in any way deceptively similar to or a colorable imitation of the plain Trademark VASANTA BHAVAN. (b) granting a permanent injunction restraining the de men, servants, agents or anyone claiming through or under them from manner passing-off the plaintiff trademark and trading style VASANT BHAVAN by using the offending trademark and trading style VASANTA BHAVAN or any other mark or marks which are similar or in any way deceptively similar to or a colourable imitation of the plaintiffs t VASANTA BHAVAN. (c) directing the defendant to render a true and faithful profits earned by them through a sale of food products bearing the o trade mark VASANTA BHAVAN and directing payment of such profits to 2/14 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(C the plaintiff by way of damages for infringement committed by the defendant. (d) to pass an order of declaration, declaring the plainti M/S.Vasanta Bhavan Hotels India ... vs Vasantha Bhavan on 2 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8711508/ 2 trademark Vasanta Bhavan as well-known mark within the meaning of Section 2(1)(zg) read with Section 11(6) of the Trademarks Act, 1999 with a direction to the Registrar of Trademarks to notify the mark V Bhavan on the register of well-known marks. e) directing the defendant to pay the plaintiff the costs For Plaintiff : Mr.Vijayan Subramanian For Defendants : Set ex parte on 18.03.2024 JUDGMENT
texts.facts: The plaintiff has filed this Civil Suit seeking permanent injunction restraining the defendant from in any manner infringing and passing off the plaintiff's trademark and trading style VASANTA BHAVAN by using the offending Trademark and Trading style VASANTA BHAVAN and to direct t h e d e f e n d a n t t o r e n d e r t h e a c c o u n t o f p r o f i t s e a r n e d b y t h e m t h r o u g h https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Comm.Div.) No.36 of 2024 the sale of food products bearing the said trademark and also to declare the plaintiff's registered trademark VASANTA BHAVAN as well-known mark. The plaintiff has taken steps to protect the trademark and trading style by applying for registration of the trademark and trading style VASANTA BHAVAN. 2.2 It is the case of the plaintiff that the defendant herein had commenced adopting identical or deceptively similar trademark and trading style VASANTHA BHAVAN in respect of their hotel business serving veg and non-veg foods. The defendant has adopted the identical trademark https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis C.S.(Comm.Div.) No.36 of 2024 and trading style VASANTHA BHAVAN to deceive the general public and to make them believe the food preparations served at the defendant place has the connection with our hotel and the defendant is associated with the plaintiff. The defendant has no manner of right to adopt and use the said offending trademark or trading style VASANTHA BHAVAN. The acts of the defendant also constitute criminal offences under the Trademark Act, 1999. Hence, the present suit has to be decreed with costs.
texts.arguments: 3. The learned counsel for the plaintiff submitted that the defendant had commenced adopting identical or deceptively similar trademark and trading style VASANTA BHAVAN in respect of their hotel business only in order to deceive the general public and to make them believe the food preparations served at the defendant place has the connection with the plaintiff's hotel and the defendant is associated with the plaintiff. The defendant has no manner of right to adopt the use the said offending trademark. If the defendant is allowed to continue the illegal acts in adopting the plaintiff's trademark and vend food preparations under the offending trademark, the plaintiff would be put to very serious loss and hardship. There is also danger of the public being cheated by the defendant by adopting the offending trademarks by misleading the public to believe the food p r e p a r a t i o n s b e i n g s o l d b y t h e d e f e n d a n t i n c o n n e c t i n g w i t h t h e p l a i n t i f f .
